findings.location: Definition (c), paragraph beginning “A smooth singular 3-simplex σ is non-null at a parameter point”
findings.evidence: The item defines “nondegenerate” for a 3-dimensional subspace, then applies it to the span of three simplex velocities without explicitly requiring that span to have dimension 3. The cited def-smooth-singular-simplex allows degenerate parametrizations, so for rank-deficient maps the predicate is not defined by this item's preceding definition. State that the velocity span has rank 3 and is nondegenerate before calling the simplex non-null.

findings.location: Definition (a), paragraph beginning “A smooth metric family at g with compactly supported variation”
findings.evidence: The family definition requires each fixed g_s to be a smooth Lorentzian metric and to agree with g off one compact set, but it does not require differentiable or smooth dependence on s. The next paragraph defines q^{ab}=d(g_s^{ab})/ds|_0 and asserts q is a smooth tensor field. Require joint smoothness in (s,p) in charts, or explicitly require this derivative to exist as a smooth tensor field.

The Statement assumes (H1)–(H4) for one compactly supported ξ, but step 4.1 varies ξ over every chart-supported test field to infer ∇^aT_{ab}=0. For ξ=0 the flow is the identity and (H1)–(H4) can hold while giving no test information about T. Require (H1)–(H4) for every compactly supported smooth ξ, or weaken the conclusion to the integral identity for the chosen ξ.

findings.location: Postulate (iii)–(iv), especially the paragraph after the numbered matter sectors
findings.evidence: Clause (iii) says the dust and perfect-fluid sectors have no supplied matter action and prescribe T directly. Clause (iv) nevertheless states stationarity of a total action for the action presentation, then redirects those sectors to the direct equation. This conflicts with the action-presentation classification and the exactly-one-presentation rule. Restrict the action presentation to sectors with a supplied Hilbert action, or supply and justify actions for the prescribed-T sectors.
